replies.author: Clijmart
replies.body:
Saw this ingame when flying around, and was amazed. Looks really nice!

Gameplay wouldn't be as great though.
I'll try and help ingame when I see you online, but incase I can't:
- Add more islands to reduce void
- Make the map bigger (Simply said: move spawns/monuments further away from eachother and fill the space)
- More pvp space (More islands wouls partly fix this issue, but also making the islands bigger and have a bit more open space would help)
- Try not to have overpoweres enchantments in chests, these will get really annoying and could ruin the whole game.

Overall the map looks amazing, but I think it wouldn't play well in its current state.

Good job/luck ;)

replies.author: Passively
replies.body:
Hello, I'm sorry but your map has been denied due to the following reason:
  •  The map is very small with a lot of void; gameplay wouldn't be the best.
We recommend you to follow the points that Clijmart said above, you may resubmit once these edits have been made.

~Passively.
